# `membership-plan` commands

## `membership-plan create`

Define a membership plan: a name and one existing price level that enrolled customers are priced at on invoices dated inside their enrollment. No fee, renewal or payment is implied. Example: "Trade members" at price level "Member Price". The membership pricing layer must be on (`company update --membership-pricing-enabled true`); off, the command is refused with E_FEATURE_DISABLED and prices resolve as they always have.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | promotion.manage |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/membership-plan.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow membership-plan create --name "Trade members" --price-level "Preferred Customer" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Trade member pricing" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "membership-plan create", "input": {"name": "Trade members", "price_level": "Preferred Customer"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `--name` | string | yes | no | — | Plan name, unique, such as "Trade members".; minimum length 1; maximum length 200 |
| `price_level` | `--price-level` | string | yes | no | — | ID or name of an existing active home-currency price level members are priced at.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `description` | `--description` | string \| null | no | yes | null | What the plan is for; internal only. |

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/membership-plan.create`

## `membership-plan update`

Rename a membership plan, point it at another price level, or deactivate it, with its expected version. New invoices use the change; saved invoices keep the level they captured. The membership pricing layer must be on (`company update --membership-pricing-enabled true`); off, the command is refused with E_FEATURE_DISABLED and prices resolve as they always have.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | promotion.manage |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/membership-plan.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow membership-plan update 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --expected-version 1 --active false --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Plan withdrawn" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "membership-plan update", "input": {"plan": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV", "expected_version": 1, "active": false}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plan` | `PLAN` | string | yes | no | — | Membership plan ID or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `name` | `--name` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |

| `active` | `--active` | boolean \| null | no | yes | null | false stops new enrollments and new invoices using the plan; saved invoices keep their prices. |
